description: Native floating overlay showing AI provider usage limits (Claude, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Google Antigravity, xAI Grok, Cursor)
notes: AI Limits keeps any key or token you paste, and its own Cursor sign-in, in Windows Credential Manager (service 'ailimits').
'scoop uninstall' does not remove them: use Remove and Sign out under each provider's Sign-in in Settings first, or delete the 'ailimits' entries in Credential Manager.
